summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband access for schools and libraries, citing budget constraints and cost implications.

claims.argument: Adding a six-figure connectivity bill would come straight out of staffing
claims.evidence_quote: Our district is already on a tight budget. Adding a six-figure connectivity bill would come straight out of staffing because there is nowhere else for it to come from.

filer_raw: Alejandra Villafuerte | J. Sterling Morton High School
